metadata.name: Sharingan / 写轮眼
metadata.description:
Sharingan provides a complete, shape-aware generated-floor map with ranked special-room colors. Large and L-shaped rooms use their real footprints. Boss Rooms have a black B; visited special rooms turn gray. MCM-configurable shortcuts. Defaults: F6 / Left Stick click.
写轮眼显示完整、按真实形状绘制的楼层地图和特殊房间。Boss 房使用黑色 B，已访问房间变为灰色。 支持 MCM 键盘/手柄快捷键；默认 F6 / 按下左摇杆。
